scope: Metadata input payload factoring only; WE, addresses, state, protocol and all processing cycles preserved.

unit.assertions: Every clock: data_we/data_wa/data_w/data_ra/meta_we/meta_wa equal exact original block; meta_w equal on every enabled write, including collision-poison consumer.

proof: Every old enabled metadata write is one of INIT zero, ALLOC clean-tag, W_WAIT/W_GET dirty-tag, MAINT zero, maintenance WB_DATA zero. Candidate changes only unconsumed payload when WE=0. Both RAM storage and collision-poison consumers are WE-qualified. No assumptions about reachable states are needed for this case split.
harness_note: unit-v1 preserved: exactOS30SET_BITS8 directed conflict tests exceeded the generic16,384-word host array (word17,018). unit-v2 increases only host array capacity to65,536 words while preserving addresses/random bounds/transactions. No RTL/assertion failure caused the rerun.
limitations: CPU/audio/bridge/scanout traffic is synthetic. No actual CPU core or audio mixer is instantiated.
The inherited controller model is split-DQ MiSTer io_sdram_test, not Pocket PHY.

Fast-texture/native-mesh external ports are tied idle; this directed0x4E/clear test exercises the raster/write path. Native/particle worker jobs are covered in the separate fullGPU capture and worker lockstep gates.
No Dock/output-video, whole-device FPS, audio PCM or physical timing claim.
inherited_refresh_warning: One inherited refresh interval1701 cycles versus limit1700 appears identically in both runs and prior control. No claim of physical DRAM retention/timing closure.
